    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.

Staggering Punch I

Monk · Level 15

Effect

A well-aimed attack that deals melee damage plus 113 and stuns your opponent for an instant, interrupting spell casting. Increases Jin by 1. Spell interrupt only works on targets that are not immune to stun.

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

Level in 2007
15
Cast then
Instant
A well aimed attack that does 50% damage, and staggers your opponent for 8 secs. Increase Jin by 1

vanguardmonks.com, 2007 · every ability that changed

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Spell interrupt only works on targets that are not immune to stun. Staggered Dazed Can be learned at level 15 via Aum of the Stumbling Master.

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “A well-aimed attack that deals melee damage plus 113 and stuns your opponent for an instant, interrupting spell casting. Increase Jin by 1” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:staggering-punch-i)

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.

rows.detail_main_html:
Three Finger Strike

Monk · Level 50

Effect

The first move in the exploding heart technique. Strikes your opponent in the throat, dealing melee damage plus 867 and lowers its avoidance by 100% for 6 sec. Increases Jin by 1.

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

Level in 2007
50
Cast then
Instant
The first move in the exploding heart technique. Strikes your opponent in the throat with stiffened fingers Increases Jin by 1

vanguardmonks.com, 2007 · every ability that changed

Notes

The exploding heart technique is three abilities performed in order: Three Finger Strike (first), Hammer Fist (second) and Palm Explodes the Heart (final). Each tooltip names its own place in the sequence but not the others.

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Chain melee attack which lowers opponent's avoidance (6 sec) (grants 1 Jin) (only available after landing a melee critical hit)” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:three-finger-strike)

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.
